brief: A zero-dependency digital publication and interactive simulator hub hosted on GitHub Pages (lolyeah.github.io). Bridges rigorous domain evidence with editorial visual craft across clinical psychiatry, automotive tech, macroeconomics, and physical sciences.
criteria: Success: unskewed geometric precision, flawless 16px favicon legibility, zero gradient or drop-shadow artifacting, full WCAG 2.2 contrast compliance.

concepts.name: Precision Interlock
concepts.idea: An unskewed Swiss geometric monogram of L and Y on an exact 60°/90° grid.
rationale: Preserves established brand equity and signature Emerald (#059669) & Indigo (#4f46e5) palette
Calibrated 14px optical channel ensures razor-sharp clarity down to 16px favicons
Pure mathematical geometry scoring 100/100 in production readiness with zero gradient slop

recommendation: Precision Interlock — delivers timeless editorial authority, honors existing brand equity, and solves every technical and optical failure of the legacy mark.
next_steps: Deploy full icon and asset suite to GitHub Pages repository
Adopt updated brand guidelines across editorial monographs and social headers
Maintain high-contrast light and dark theme pairing
